VERIFIED 48h + 72h (PostgreSQL, meta_rsi ground truth):

PATTERN 1 — Counter-trend LONG bleed, escalated: 72h LONG n=46 net -$2.18 (37% WR) vs SHORT n=14 net +$0.26 (43% WR). Kill-zone meta_rsi 48-62 LONGs (48h): n=14 net -$0.68, 43% WR. Worst recent: ME -0.26 (bb-bounce-v2, stale_exit, mRSI 53.3), ARB -0.10 (ai-trader+, hard_max_loss, 51.4), LDO -0.10 (ai-trader+, 53.6). WINNING side on all: SHORT or flat. Why we missed it: signals fire long on RSI dip without regime confirmation. Fix: ai-trader must default SHORT in this regime.

PATTERN 2 — ai-trader+ regime blindness, 72h: 15 LONG trades net -$0.56 (33% WR). The 3-loss streak (ARB/DOGE/LDO) is a subset of a broader pattern: mid-RSI LONGs in SHORT_BIAS tape. SHORT ai-trader trades also net -$0.10 (n=6, 33% WR) — but sample is tiny and one was a BTC SHORT caught in a bounce. Fix is pick quality + regime gate discipline, not signal param change (brain auditor's job).

PATTERN 3 — Exit mechanics fine, entries wrong: losses are hard_max_loss / atr_sl_hit / stale_exit — stops working as designed. Winners exit via profit-monster-trail / rr_engine_trail correctly. No SL misplacement epidemic. The problem is 100% entry-side: wrong direction, wrong RSI band. Do not touch exit params.

PATTERN 4 — SHORT scarcity persistent: 2 SHORTs vs 15 LONGs in 24h. HBAR pump-chain- SHORT was the clean win (+0.07, mRSI 54.5). One BTC SHORT loss (-0.06) was a bounce catch. WINNING side available all day; signal zoo is long-heavy. Keep preferring SHORT candidates in ai-trader.
